confidence_notes: A May 2026 Numbeo Oxford result reports typical meal, mid-range meal, draft beer and cappuccino prices. Cocktail and wine estimates are inferred from local beer prices; accommodation is a holistic July estimate and is less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation reflects Oxford's university and visitor demand, broadly comparable to Cambridge and other high-cost southern English university cities; food and drink benchmarks are Oxford-specific.
